selector_metric: original equal mean standardized two-target MAE on averaged state
training: original V12 jointTabM; .5*iron_std_squared_error+.5*huber2(time_std_residual), where huber2(r)=r^2 if abs(r)<=1 else 2*abs(r)-1

controls.source: original SWA_WINDOW10 in local/runs/tabm-time-swa-v1 and local/runs/tabm-time-swa-confirm-271828-314159-20261001; original physical identities retained

gates.development: two complete candidate A20 gains vs latest frozen Q75 positive AND mean mechanism vs original MSE SWA positive
gates.confirmation: four complete gains positive, one-sided seed tLCB95(df3)>0, mean mechanism vs original MSE SWA positive

seed_history: four previously used split seeds over same official sample pool; split stability evidence, not new independent datasets
failure_policy: preserve failure and consumed reservations, never repeat fit; zero-fit engineering repair authorized by user

loss.time: huber2: squared error for |standardized residual|<=1, else 2*abs(residual)-1
loss.gradient_scale_note: central value and gradients identical to original joint MSE; time gradients capped for residual magnitude >1

queue: single user-authorized next optimization; not a platform release
selection_retention: original formal development/confirmation gates preserved; failure of relative mechanism gate does not discard positive-gain platform exploration
